_about: Visible revision history. Add an entry whenever a page's facts change; pages show the entries whose path matches. type: published | updated | corrected | verified | restructured.

entries.summary: Removed an unsourced government infrastructure figure; each reported development figure is now listed with what it counts and its source.
Corrected the weekday of the second Amrit Snan date (31 August 2027 is a Tuesday) and relabelled the dates as 'reported' until the Authority's notice is linked.
Withdrew the unsourced '15–20 crore' visitor estimate; no single official estimate is confirmed.
Corrected the weekday of 31 August 2027 (Tuesday) and removed the 'Somvati' label that depended on it.
Added a notice that no general-visitor e-pass or registration requirement has been located in official sources.
